items.exampleEn: He plays games on his phone to fight boredom.
items.exampleZh: 他用手機玩遊戲來打發無聊。

items.exampleEn: The garden is full of delightful flowers.
items.exampleZh: 花園裡開滿了令人愉快的花。

items.exampleEn: Some people think eating insects is disgusting.
items.exampleZh: 有些人覺得吃昆蟲很噁心。

items.exampleEn: The teacher's kind words soothed the nervous students.
items.exampleZh: 老師溫和的話安撫了緊張的學生。

items.exampleEn: His blush showed that he liked her.
items.exampleZh: 他一臉紅，就看得出他喜歡她。

items.exampleEn: It was amusing to watch the puppy chase its own shadow.
items.exampleZh: 看小狗追自己的影子很好玩。

items.exampleEn: Watching the sad news every night is depressing.
items.exampleZh: 每晚看悲傷的新聞令人沮喪。
items.glossZh: 令人沮喪的；令人消沉的

items.exampleEn: There was a lot of fuss about the new teacher.
items.exampleZh: 大家對新老師議論紛紛。

items.sentenceEn: The smell from the trash was disgusting.

items.audioEn: My little brother made a big fuss because his ice cream fell on the floor.
items.audioZh: 我弟弟因為冰淇淋掉到地上而大吵大鬧。
options: He wanted a new toy car.
He lost a game to his friend.

items.sentenceEn: Soft music helps soothe the baby.
items.sentenceZh: 輕柔的音樂有助於安撫寶寶。

items.sentenceEn: The movie was amusing but a little long.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影很有趣，但有點長。

items.stemEn: What a ____ surprise to see you here! I've missed you so much.
items.stemZh: 在這裡見到你，真是令人愉快的驚喜！我好想你。

items.stemEn: Out of ____, the kids started counting the cars on the road.
items.stemZh: 因為無聊，孩子們開始數路上的車子。

items.passageEn: During the long holiday, it rained every day. The gray weather was depressing, and my little sister complained of boredom. My mom tried to soothe her by reading her an amusing book. Then my grandma came to visit, and we had a delightful afternoon eating her lemon cake. My sister wanted to cook, too, but she used salt instead of sugar in her cookies. They tasted disgusting! The kitchen was also very messy. She didn't make a fuss; she just laughed, with a blush on her face.
items.passageZh: 長假期間每天都在下雨。灰濛濛的天氣令人沮喪，我妹妹一直抱怨好無聊。媽媽讀了一本有趣的書給她聽，試著安撫她。後來奶奶來看我們，我們吃著她做的檸檬蛋糕，度過了一個愉快的下午。妹妹也想下廚，但她做餅乾時把鹽當成了糖。餅乾噁心得難以下嚥！廚房也變得很凌亂。她沒有大驚小怪，只是笑了，臉上泛起一陣紅暈。

options: 讀一本有趣的書給她聽
帶她去附近的商店買新玩具

questions.questionZh: 妹妹做的餅乾為什麼難吃？
options: 她烤的時間太久，全都烤焦了

items.promptZh: 我覺得這個結局很令人沮喪。
referenceEn: I think this ending is depressing.
rubricZh: depressing 表示「令人沮喪的」，例如 a depressing ending 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 他的笑話很有趣，大家都笑了。
referenceEn: His jokes were so amusing that everyone laughed.
His jokes were very amusing, and everybody laughed.
rubricZh: 用 amusing 表示「有趣的；好笑的」
時態配合內容（例如 were、are 等）
